items.transcript: A lot of other cleaners will disagree with this. I love the chaotic clients. Can you fit it in today? I'm like, yes, we can. We can just come swoop in like a nine shining armor and literally solve all of their problems. And they're going to walk into that unit or they're going to walk into their house and they're going to be like, it's like going to be like the angel gates are opening. They're like, oh my God. And they like cry and they call us and they thank us. And I love being that person. Anyway, the way that we're able to do that without getting lots and lots of complaints, because that I think is usually the thing that drives cleaners away from the last minute like chaos. It tends to be the kind of people who complain. I actually think that that's usually a sales motion because the day of you're trying to book that client, everything gets like fast tracked. So you skip your cleaning agreement, you skip the walkthrough, you skip your normal sales pitch. You kind of do things to make the process go faster. But I have a very simple, easy way to go through the exact same process that we go through with everybody else. That way we can fit in the last minute chaotic clients, increase our revenue, keep those clients on for recurring because we were just their nine shining armor. And yeah, everybody's happy. And I'm able to do that through Jobber. It's super duper simple. So essentially all we do is the same sales motion. So we take them through a walkthrough. I'm able to get all the specifications from the client to know what exactly needs done. That is then going to be translated over into their Jobber profile. Their Jobber profile is going to have two sections to it. Actually three. The first two sections are going to be the notes within the profile. We're going to have two separate notes, one cleaner specific note and one admin only note. The cleaner specific note will be what the cleaners actually see on site. You can see everything listed here with just important notes that they'll definitely need to be able to complete the clean. Then down here, you're going to see the internal admin notes. These are potentially notes that we just don't need or want the cleaning team to see. There is also a special checklist that gets put into their Jobber profile. That checklist is going to be specifically built for that home. I would highly recommend Jobber. It is what I use in my cleaning company for what, five years. And I always recommend when I see somebody using a different software to switch over because this literally is so simple and has everything that you need. If you want to try Jobber for free, make sure to click the link in my bio.
